DOP: nikkhepa m. [ S. nikṣepa], 1. ( i ) the putting down, setting down, laying down; a deposit, pledge ; Vin I 298, 21 (paccayā saṅghāṭiyā ~āya); D II 305, 17 (maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷevarassa ~o); Ja VI 180, 11* (~e dhāraṇāya vā); Bv 2:143 (paṭhavī nāma suciṃ pi asuciṃ pi ca sabbaṃ sahati ~aṃ; Bv-a 109, 28 : ~an ti nikkhittaṃ); Mil 91, 18 (mahāpaṭhavī ~aṃ arahati ~e upagate); — ( ii ) the trace, prints, of the setting down ; Vin I 16, 15 (addasa kho seṭṭhi gahapati suvaṇṇapādukānaṃ ~aṃ disvāna taṃ yeva anugamāsi); — ifc see pada-; — 2. the setting out, setting down (of a mātikā ); the setting forth, promulgation (of a sutta ); a list of headings, a brief statement (to be developed) ; Vism 536, 29 (~e viseso hoti); Sv 51, 22 foll. (evaṃ imesu catusu ~esu imassa suttassa aṭṭhuppattiko ~o aṭṭhuppattiyaṃ hi idaṃ bhagavatā nikkhittaṃ); Mp II 336, 30 (duvidho ~o aṭṭhuppattiko pi pucchāvasiko pi); Ud-a 30, 3 foll. (nikkhipanan ti ~o suttassa ~o suttanikkhepo suttadesanā ti attho, nikkhipīyatī ti vā ~o suttam eva ~o suttanikkhepo) ≠ It-a I 35, 23 foll ; As 6, 33* (mūlato … nāmato cāpi liṅgato nikkhipitvā desitattā ~o ti pavuccati; cf Dhs 981 foll. ); — ifc see mātikā-, sutta- ( sv sutta 2 ); — °- gahaṇa , n. [nikkhepa + gahaṇa 1 ], the taking of a deposit or pledge ; Pj II 179, 8 (~ena … iṇaṃ gahetvā).
NCP: masculine the putting down, setting down, laying down; a deposit, pledge. the trace, prints, of the setting down.
